long_biography.plain_text:
Investment entrepreneur Monica Monajem shaped The Amitis Group around private-wealth advice and investment management. She began in mergers and acquisitions, then moved into private wealth and co-founded an advisory firm focused on sustainable technologies, natural resources and alternative materials. In 2017 she established Amitis as a broader platform for wealth planning, portfolio construction and investment management.

Venture investing in sustainable technology and strategies for digital assets broadened the platform. Monajem remains founder and chief executive, directing a business that works with private clients and professional investors. Her work also includes investing in early-stage technology companies. She retains decisive control of Amitis Partners, while client portfolios, fund assets and charitable trusts remain legally separate.

uncertainties.detail: The official Amitis website consistently uses Monica Monajem. UK corporate records also use Monica Monajem Isfahani for the Amitis Partners controller, matching her January 1983 birth month, British nationality, England residence and career appointments. The dossier treats Isfahani as a verified fuller legal or corporate-record name variant, but does not alter the established professional display name or guess whether it is a married surname.

The authoritative record already marks gender as Female, consistent with Companies House's Ms title and published female pronouns. No strong public source names a spouse, parent, child or other relative relevant to identity or wealth origin, so no family relationship is inferred from either Monajem or Isfahani.

Monajem's direct founder ownership of Amitis Partners is established. Preqin describes the wider Amitis Group as a family office holding assets on behalf of her family, but does not identify who supplied those assets or how they were acquired. Wealth origin therefore remains Unknown rather than being labelled self-made or inherited.

Monajem's documented personal interest is her founder equity and control in Amitis Partners. Amitis client portfolios, fund assets, assets under management, family holdings, charitable trusts and companies where she acts only as a director cannot be treated as her personal wealth or net worth.

Companies House establishes January 1983 and current England or United Kingdom residence, but not a birth day, place of birth or birth country. British nationality does not establish birthplace, so those fields remain blank.

No dedicated Forbes person profile was found. No personal LinkedIn, Instagram or personal website met the verification threshold; the official Amitis company website is proposed under the separate Company Website type.
Politics, controversies, allegations, legal matters, sanctions, irrelevant private-family detail and all private-vessel research were excluded.
